note: Berkeley County's own zoning covers only the Tuscarora and Windewald districts, published as PDF ordinances and district maps; most of the county is unzoned (county FAQ). The only queryable zoning polygons found are City of Martinsburg layers on ArcGIS Online (PlanningDeptData_Zones, PlanningDeptData_Transects, owner adotson): 6 and 5 features, last edited 2020, and 1 of 3 sampled polygons invalid in each, so both fail the valid-polygons check (90% needed). No official county zoning service was found.
